description: Java class implementing media session management for Android, handling media controls, audio focus, and metadata updates within the Cobalt project.

classes.name: CobaltMediaSession
classes.description: Manages Android media session, handles media controls, audio focus, and metadata updates for media playback.

classes.name: MediaMetadata
classes.description: Holds media metadata such as title, artist, album, artwork, and duration.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the media session is active.

methods.name: setLifecycleCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to notify when media session becomes active or inactive.

methods.name: setMediaSession
methods.description: Initializes and configures the media session with controls and metadata.

methods.name: checkMainLooperThread
methods.description: Ensures methods are called on the main thread.

methods.name: configureMediaFocus
methods.description: Configures wake lock, audio focus, and media session state based on playback state.

methods.name: deactivateMediaSession
methods.description: Releases and deactivates the media session.

methods.name: wakeLock
methods.description: Enables or disables the screen wake lock.

methods.name: audioFocus
methods.description: Requests or abandons audio focus.

methods.name: requestAudioFocus
methods.description: Requests audio focus (pre-API 26).

methods.name: requestAudioFocusV26
methods.description: Requests audio focus using AudioFocusRequest (API 26+).

methods.name: abandonAudioFocus
methods.description: Abandons audio focus (pre-API 26).

methods.name: abandonAudioFocusV26
methods.description: Abandons audio focus using AudioFocusRequest (API 26+).

methods.name: onAudioFocusChange
methods.description: Handles changes in audio focus, adjusts volume, and controls playback accordingly.

methods.name: getAudioManager
methods.description: Retrieves the system AudioManager service.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes media playback.

methods.name: resumeInternal
methods.description: Internal resume logic, updates media focus.

methods.name: suspend
methods.description: Suspends media playback.

methods.name: suspendInternal
methods.description: Internal suspend logic, releases media focus.

methods.name: updateMediaSession
methods.description: Updates media session state, metadata, and playback info.

methods.name: updateMediaSessionInternal
methods.description: Internal logic to update media session with new playback state and metadata.

methods.name: updatePlaybackState
methods.description: Updates the playback state in the media session.

methods.name: updateMetadata
methods.description: Updates media metadata in the media session.

methods.name: onArtworkLoaded
methods.description: Callback when artwork is loaded; updates metadata artwork.
